flags.message: outcome.json records interim_signals.amicus_briefs = 0, but the 2026-09-04 snapshot shows an amicus brief (Initiative and Referendum Institute) submitted Sep 03 2026, the same day as the denial. The docket lists the denial entry before the amicus entry, so a count cut at the order plausibly gives 0; worth a look because the interim-v1 amicus-increment claim resolves on this field for all three candidates. Not corrected here - the outcome is not mine to edit.

codex-baseline's retrieval.md describes three CourtListener MCP opinion searches and a fetch of the 43-page application PDF; its retrieval_log.json (coverage 0.6, 10 rows) carries none of those calls, only statpack shell reads and two harness-redacted credential-shaped rows. Graded as a telemetry capture gap, not against the candidate; noting it so the capture profile for that engine's MCP and fetch calls can be checked.
